# Will an e-bike rental fleet pay for itself?

> Free e-bike rental business calculator: enter your bikes, busy and quiet days, utilization, half-day and full-day prices, staff, rent, batteries and any loan, and see season profit, payback, break-even utilization and the lowest rental prices. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
